title: Tech Demo Pack #1
description: A Collection of Four Tech Demonstrations, Created so I can Make Higher Quality Full Projects
body:
## Intro
After a considerably long time making mods for Minecraft, I have made some pretty bad projects. Fortunately, I am able to learn from my mistakes. I recently took the time to make small feature projects, only for the purpose of honing my skills. I didn't even plan on publishing them, but I figured I might as well. Let me make this clear; **THIS IS NOT FOR SURVIVAL MODE GAMEPLAY!**
## Feature Packs
Ingame, there is info cards explaining the reasons why I made certain things, as well as advancements detailing what is included, but here is the four things added.  
1. The Goomba
2. The Box Puncher
3. The Rot Caves
4. Better End Island Generation  
I reccomend checking out what these do, and playing around with them! That's all from me!
